note.title: Present perfect and a reading log · Notes

note.title: Modal verbs and degrees of certainty · Notes
note.summary: Understand modal verbs and degrees of certainty through a connected example and explain each answer using the passage.

note.title: Distinguishing fact from opinion · Notes
note.summary: Understand distinguishing fact from opinion through a connected example and explain each answer using the passage.

Dua mesin masing-masing 18 risalah seminit menghasilkan 36 risalah seminit bersama-sama.
